goal: Follow-ups to PRA-12 and the CodeRabbit review on PR #46. (1) The target budget also respects the report's 1024-fact guard: the evaluator computes the facts left after inventory and per-advisory facts and caps targets by the per-target fact cost, so a host with very many PHP packages degrades to a blocked coverage entry instead of aborting. (2) Ranking prefers distinct runtimes: the first FPM worker per (executable, version) ranks with web workers, further identical pool children rank after packages, so a CLI of another PHP version or a package is not pushed out by identical children. (3) The report summary carries an omitted_subject_count. (4) Gap text wording is clear and truncation is marked. (5) CodeRabbit: the ground truth records the reader's start status and an isolated-store result is accepted only when the reader started successfully without finding the writer's value; the FastCGI client reads exactly the required header, content and padding bytes and fails on EOF or timeout. No verdict logic changes.
